data.description: Customizable 4- to 6-bedroom villas in a gated community, blending luxury and flexibility for an elevated lifestyle.

data.answer:
Residents get to experience a tranquil lifestyle surrounded by rich green spaces in Harmony 3, perfect for nature lovers. The community’s resort-like amenities include Lagoon Al Ghaf, an artificial lake with sandy beach views, an 11 km cycling track, 18 km of scenic walkways, and themed parks. 

Residents enjoy exclusive Tilal Al Ghaf Harmony 3 amenities such as lakeside BBQ areas and a fully-equipped outdoor gym, creating a staycation atmosphere right at home.

Harmony 3 offers 292 luxury villas in Tilal Al Ghaf, featuring spacious 4, 5, and 6-bedroom layouts, each with customizable Garden Suites to fit individual preferences. 

With plot sizes ranging from 4,016 sq. ft. to 6,515 sq. ft., the ground floor includes a formal living and dining area, closed and show kitchens, a mud room, a powder room, and an ensuite guest room. These Harmony 3 villas for sale include landscaped gardens, outdoor swimming pools, and patios with dedicated dining and family areas, perfect for luxurious outdoor living.

The upper floor is designed with bedrooms, a cozy family living area, and a spacious terrace, while the master suite boasts a dressing room and a private balcony for ultimate comfort.

Buying a Property in Harmony 3

Tilal Al Ghaf Harmony 3 by Majid Al Futtaim offers four unique garden suite layouts with 4 and 5-bedroom villas, while the larger 5-bedroom and 6-bedroom villas feature three customizable configurations. 

The payment plan is designed for convenience, with a 10% down payment required at booking and the remaining balance spread over 5 years in a 60/40 plan. Additionally, the developer covers 50% of the Dubai Land Department (DLD) registration fees, reducing the upfront costs for buyers who only need to pay the remaining 50%.

The sub-community offers a serene blend of luxury, green spaces, and resort-style amenities. Let’s take a closer look at what life is like here.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Harmony 3

As the area is still developing, public transportation options are mainly found in the neighboring communities. Residents can drive 8 minutes to Dubai Sports City to access buses F37 and F38. 

For those using the metro, the nearest station is Jumeirah Golf Estates on the Red Line, about an 18-minute drive away. 

As for parking, each home in Harmony 3 will feature dedicated parking spaces.

Supermarkets Around Harmony 3, Tilal Al Ghaf

Residents of Harmony 3 can conveniently shop for daily essentials at Carrefour, located within the Tilal Al Ghaf community. For more options, nearby supermarkets such as Al Maya and Spinneys are just a short drive away, offering extensive grocery selections.

Shopping Malls Near Harmony 3

As the community is still under development, there are no malls within the area. However, once completed, the master Tilal Al Ghaf community will feature Distrikt. It will house many retail outlets, renowned boutiques and restaurants.

For more options, residents can access Cityland Mall which is a 22-minute drive from Harmony 3.

School in Harmony 3

The community will be home to RGS Guildford Dubai - an international school.

Mosques in and Near Harmony 3

The developer, Majid Al Futtaim, has announced that besides many facilities, Harmony 3 will feature a mosque. Other nearby options include Sports City Mosque at an 8-minute drive and Al Rahman Mosque at a 12-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Harmony 3

For medical services, residents can visit Apex Medical and Dental Clinics or Mediclinic Me’aisem, both located just 10 to 15 minutes away. For more comprehensive care, NMC Royal Hospital DIP, one of the UAE’s largest multi-specialty hospitals, is accessible within a 16-minute drive. 

Location & Nearby Areas

It is a sub-community within Tilal Al Ghaf, strategically positioned near Dubai Sports City and across from Dubai Studio City. It is surrounded by several established residential areas, including DAMAC Hills and Jumeirah Golf Estates, offering easy access to a range of amenities and lifestyle options. more_info.question: Things to Do in Harmony 3, Tilal Al Ghaf

data.answer:
From scenic parks to lakeside BBQs, there are plenty of things to do in Harmony 3. Here’s what residents can expect from this upcoming new project in Dubai.

Restaurants

Upon completion, the project will feature a variety of dining options within the community. In the meantime, residents can explore numerous restaurants near Tilal Al Ghaf in the surrounding areas, such as Grills & More Restaurant, Seven Stones Restaurant, Reddy Roasts, and Royal Grill Restaurant.

Beach in Harmony 3

The residents will have access to a lake within the community with sandy beach views.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Designed with wide open spaces and lush green areas, this community is perfect for families seeking a tranquil environment. A range of top amenities in Harmony 3, Tilal Al Ghaf are aimed at enhancing everyday living, ensuring residents have access to everything they need right at their doorstep.

  • Expansive green areas, parks, and landscaped gardens.
  • Cycling and jogging tracks with three outdoor fitness stations.
  • Community center with separate swimming pools for adults and kids, a fitness club, yoga pavilion, and a play area.
  • Sports courts for tennis, basketball, table tennis, and beach volleyball.
  • Recreational spaces like Water Splash Park, Trampoline Park, Skate Park, and Central Park.
  • RGS Guildford Dubai international school within the community.
  • Water sports facilities, including kayaking and paddleboarding, along with swimming pools.
  • Healthcare and daycare centers for convenience.
  • Indoor and outdoor gyms, plus dedicated yoga spaces.
  • Open-air cinema for entertainment.
  • A mosque for religious needs.
  • Six children’s play areas and a dedicated gardening space in the southern section.

Community Events

Harmony 3 will host community events that bring residents together, fostering a vibrant and social atmosphere.

Attractions and Landmarks

Harmony 3 offers convenient access to several key attractions and landmarks. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) is just 10 minutes away, ensuring seamless connectivity to other parts of Dubai. 

Motorsport fans can reach the Dubai Autodrome in just 12 minutes. For shopping and leisure, Cityland Mall is only 22 minutes away, and Al Maktoum International Airport is a 29-minute drive, making travel hassle-free.

Harmony 3, Tilal Al Ghaf residents can look forward to a peaceful, family-oriented lifestyle surrounded by green spaces and top-notch amenities. The community is designed to offer a perfect blend of tranquility and convenience, with quick access to key roads, making it ideal for those seeking a luxurious yet serene environment while staying connected to the city's vibrant offerings.

more_info.question: FAQs About Harmony 3, Tilal Al Ghaf Community

data.answer:
What makes the villas in Harmony 3 unique compared to other communities?

Harmony 3 villas are not just homes—they offer customizable layouts, allowing residents to create spaces like a personal gym, creative studio, or home office. It’s luxury living with a personal touch!

Are there any special perks for buyers investing in Harmony 3?

Yes, buyers enjoy a flexible 60/40 payment plan over five years and a 50% waiver on Dubai Land Department (DLD) registration fees, making it an attractive investment opportunity.

Can I enjoy water activities as a resident of Harmony 3?

Absolutely! Residents have access to Lagoon Al Ghaf, where you can enjoy kayaking, paddleboarding, and other water sports, perfect for a leisurely weekend.

How close are the shopping and dining options from Harmony 3?

As per the masterplan by the developer, the community itself will feature various retail and dining outlets, while nearby hubs like Dubai Sports City and Dubai Studio City offer additional options just minutes away.

Will there be dedicated spaces for fitness enthusiasts in Harmony 3?

Yes, the community is perfect for active lifestyles, with jogging and cycling tracks, outdoor fitness stations, a fully-equipped gym, and yoga pavilions to keep you fit and energized.

Harmony 3 in Tilal Al Ghaf is an exclusive residential sub-community developed by Majid Al Futtaim, featuring spacious 4 to 6-bedroom villas with customizable layouts. Each villa offers flexible spaces, allowing residents to personalize their homes to suit their unique preferences. This gated community is designed with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring an elevated lifestyle for every resident.

The family-friendly neighborhood of Harmony 3 in Tilal Al Ghaf is known for its walkable design, making it perfect for families and pet owners. It boasts natural open spaces, lush gardens, scenic parks, and beautifully landscaped walkways, creating a serene and refreshing environment. This thoughtfully planned community is ideal for those seeking a peaceful yet luxurious living experience.

Strategically located, Harmony 3 in Tilal Al Ghaf offers residents quick access to major roads like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) via Hessa Street (D61) and Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street (D54). This prime location ensures convenient connectivity to the rest of Dubai, making it an excellent choice for families seeking a balanced lifestyle close to the city’s key destinations.
